title: stack block props
description: A stack (« Pile »): several contents that follow one another in the same place of a timed screen, each with its moment (its blocks' timing.in), as objects stacked on a Storyline slide. The stack takes the size of its largest content, so nothing moves around it when one replaces another. Its contents are the blocks of its items slot; each shows from its moment until the next one's (or its own timing.out). On a screen without a timeline the contents stack one under the other.
x-ai-instructions: Use on narrated slides to show successive visuals in one place as the voice names them (a printer offline, then an error message, then a diagram). Give every content a timing.in anchored to the word that brings it; the first may start with its step. Do not use for content learners must compare side by side.

x-slots.label: Contents
x-slots.description: The contents, in the order they come.

transition.description: How a content gives way to the next, unless the content sets its own effect: crossfade (one fades out as the next fades in), cut (at once), slide (the next comes from the right).
